messages.content: 如何烹飪五隻雞的食譜？

function.name: recipe_calculator_calculate_time
function.description: Calculates the time to cook a recipe based on weight and per unit time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: The weight of the item to be cooked. This is a float type value.

per_unit_time.description: The time required to cook per unit weight.

unit_of_time.description: Unit of time, such as minutes or hours. Default is minutes.

message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "如何烹飪五隻雞的食譜？" meaning "How to cook a recipe for five chickens?" They want a recipe for cooking five chickens. We can provide a recipe. Possibly they want cooking time? We can use the function to calculate cooking time: weight of item to be cooked, per unit time. But we don't have weight. We could estimate weight of a chicken ~1.5 kg each, so 5 chickens ~7.5 kg. Per unit time maybe 20 minutes per kg? But typical roasting chicken: 20 minutes per 500g? Actually typical: 20 minutes per 500g at 180°C. So per unit weight 20 minutes per 0.5 kg => 40 minutes per kg. So per unit time 40 minutes per kg. So total time 7.5 kg * 40 min = 300 min = 5 hours. But that's too long. Actually typical roast chicken: 20 minutes per 500g => 40 min per kg. So 7.5 kg => 300 min = 5 hours. That seems high. But maybe we can give a recipe with steps, seasoning, cooking method, approximate time. We can also call the function to calculate time. Let's do that: weight=7.5, per_unit_time=40, unit_of_time="minutes". Then we can provide the result. Use function.
